A '''N'Noch''' was an intricately designed mask. [[Sha'Dria]], an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] working undercover as a [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]] at [[Bantha Traxx]] wore a N'Noch mask at all times.<ref name="WHSV">''[[Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy]]''</ref>
